cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.22)
set(YUKILINKER_CONSUMER_LANGUAGE C CACHE STRING "C or CXX")
project(YukiLinkerConsumer LANGUAGES ${YUKILINKER_CONSUMER_LANGUAGE})
set(YUKILINKER_RUNTIME_FORM archive CACHE STRING "archive or sources")
set(YUKILINKER_SOURCE_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../.." CACHE PATH "SDK source tree")
option(YUKILINKER_CONSUMER_NOEXCEPT "Disable Core exceptions and RTTI" OFF)
option(YUKILINKER_CONSUMER_CFI "Instrument the system-loaded Core" OFF)

if(YUKILINKER_RUNTIME_FORM STREQUAL "sources")
  set(YUKILINKER_CFI ${YUKILINKER_CONSUMER_CFI})
  add_subdirectory("${YUKILINKER_SOURCE_ROOT}" sdk)
else()
  find_package(YukiLinker 1 CONFIG REQUIRED)
endif()
if(YUKILINKER_CONSUMER_LANGUAGE STREQUAL "C")
  set(host "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../c_host.c")
elseif(YUKILINKER_CONSUMER_LANGUAGE STREQUAL "CXX")
  set(host "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../cpp_host.cpp")
else()
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Consumer language must be C or CXX")
endif()
add_library(core SHARED "${host}")
set_target_properties(core PROPERTIES C_STANDARD 11 CXX_STANDARD 17
  C_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden CXX_VISIBILITY_PRESET hidden VISIBILITY_INLINES_HIDDEN ON)
target_compile_definitions(core PRIVATE YUKILINKER_TEST_SHARED=1)
target_compile_options(core PRIVATE -UNDEBUG)
if(YUKILINKER_CONSUMER_LANGUAGE STREQUAL "CXX")
  target_link_options(core PRIVATE -Wl,--wrap=munmap)
  if(YUKILINKER_CONSUMER_NOEXCEPT)
    target_compile_options(core PRIVATE -fno-exceptions -fno-rtti)
    target_compile_definitions(core PRIVATE YUKILINKER_TEST_NOEXCEPT=1)
  endif()
endif()
if(YUKILINKER_RUNTIME_FORM STREQUAL "sources")
  yukilinker_add_runtime_sources(core)
elseif(YUKILINKER_RUNTIME_FORM STREQUAL "archive")
  target_link_libraries(core PRIVATE YukiLinker::runtime)
else()
  message(FATAL_ERROR "Runtime form must be archive or sources")
endif()
target_link_libraries(core PRIVATE dl)
if(YUKILINKER_CONSUMER_CFI)
  target_compile_definitions(core PRIVATE YUKILINKER_TEST_CFI=1)
  target_compile_options(core PRIVATE -flto -fsanitize=cfi-icall -fsanitize-cfi-cross-dso)
  target_link_options(core PRIVATE -flto -fsanitize=cfi-icall -fsanitize-cfi-cross-dso)
endif()
